model_output.extraction_notes: The qualifying public debt decomposition table is the row-and-column table in Figure A3 on original physical PDF page 33, headed "Contribution to Changes in Public Debt," with explicit rows such as "Change in gross public sector debt," "Identified debt-creating flows," "Primary deficit," "Automatic debt dynamics," and "Residual, including asset changes." The target year 2017 appears only inside the merged Actual range column "2009-2017," so the absolute rule prevents extraction. Figure A2 on page 32 consists of realism charts and histograms and was rejected as visualization content rather than a qualifying decomposition table. The lower debt-creating-flows panel in Figure A3 is a chart and was not used. Figure A4 on page 34 consists mainly of composition and alternative-scenario charts plus assumptions tables, not the selected public-debt decomposition block.
